title: Game profile (team artifact)
description: The owner-approved game profile: genre, platforms, input devices, budgets and which rubric lines apply. Every template reads it; the getting-started skills help the owner write it. Created by @meta_alchemist (https://x.com/meta_alchemist).

version.description: Artifact schema version the producer wrote. Same major as x-version.

id.description: Template id, or owner for files the owner makes.

createdAt.description: UTC time the file was written.

synthetic.description: True for worked examples. Consumers never treat synthetic data as a measurement.

build.description: The build the items describe, when they describe one.

key.description: Profile key, for example inputDevices or frameBudgetMs.

appliesTo.description: Template ids this key is for. Empty means all.

approved.description: True once the owner approved it.
